_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/ap.jsx APBilling (L11-99) + BillingForm (L101-154). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same pattern as gl/coa-strings.json. crumbSection/crumbScreen render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, right-arrow U+2192, baht U+0E3F) EXCEPT glAcct3 which drops the mock vendor suffix '· ซีแพคฯ' (the GL-preview box is prototype-illustrative — see ap-billing.tsx / billing-form.tsx headers). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (th) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-14). exportToast is a shared existing phrase. Export/status/edit/cancel/all reuse existing DICT keys (common.export / common.status / common.cancel / common.all) via t(), not this file.
